name: System status security feature map and route compatibility
description: Verify health, version, backup visibility, feature map, and all legacy routes remain operational.

planSteps.description: System status shows app and database health, version, backup information, latest import, decision confidence, and runbook links
The feature or phase map loads and gives working links to the implemented modules
Health returns a successful status with database reachability and version returns non-secret application metadata
Open legacy routes /radar, /calendar, /financing, /ask, /reports, /reminders, /imports, /data-quality, /assumptions, /admin, and /phases one by one
Every legacy route remains functional or redirects to its correct new workspace; none returns 404 or a server error
Use the sidebar collapse control and then expand it again
The workspace remains usable in both states and accessible labels remain available
